claims.evidence: The witness report confirms two road bicycles are present (one black, one white).
The seller's pricing strategy is a statement of intent and cannot be verified by visual inspection of the items.

risks.risk: Mechanical failure of gear shifters and brake calipers
risks.proof: A video clip showing the gears shifting through all levels and the brakes stopping the wheels.
risks.if_unproven: as non-functional/requiring a full mechanical overhaul.

risks.risk: Worn or rusted drivetrain (chain and cassette)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the chain links and the teeth on the rear cassette.
risks.if_unproven: as needing immediate replacement of the chain and gears.

risks.risk: Frame size mismatch or structural damage
risks.proof: Photo of the frame size sticker or a measurement of the seat tube.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic size with potential hidden frame fatigue.

risks.risk: Counterfeit branding (Yamaha stickers on generic frames)
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number stamped under the bottom bracket.

proof_requests: Video of both bicycles being ridden or tested for gear shifting and braking.
Close-up photos of the gear teeth and chains on both bikes.
Photos of the serial numbers located under the pedal area (bottom bracket).
Clear photos of any brand markings on the white bicycle.
response.reason: The items are clearly identified as road bicycles. They can be priced at the worst-case value for generic used road bikes in the Oyo market until functionality and authenticity are proven.
